## How it works

- [statement] Observe a representative application cycle before removing a zero-use index; infrequent reporting queries can depend on it. (medium confidence) — https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/ · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.pythian.com/blog/how-to-find-unused-index-and-drop-them-safely-in-mongodb, https://studio3t.com/whats-new/are-my-mongodb-indexes-being-used-studio3t_ama/, https://dzone.com/articles/using-mongodb-indexstats-to-identify-and-remove-unused-indexes
- [statement] Store usage metrics externally when history must survive restarts. Treat any counter reset as a new observation window when comparing samples. (medium confidence) — https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/ · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Run db.collection.aggregate([{ $indexStats: {} }]) for per-index usage documents; $indexStats must be the pipeline's first stage. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://studio3t.com/whats-new/are-my-mongodb-indexes-being-used-studio3t_ama/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] accesses.ops counts user operations that used the index; accesses.since marks when MongoDB began collecting those statistics, rather than the last access time. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://studio3t.com/whats-new/are-my-mongodb-indexes-being-used-studio3t_ama/, https://www.pythian.com/blog/how-to-find-unused-index-and-drop-them-safely-in-mongodb

## Facts and statements

- [statement] A mongod restart resets index statistics; dropping and recreating an index also starts a new statistics window. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/
- [statement] Modifying an existing index through collMod resets that index's statistics; changing its hidden state is a documented example. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.hideIndex.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.unhideIndex.md, https://studio3t.com/whats-new/are-my-mongodb-indexes-being-used-studio3t_ama/
- [statement] Hiding a visible index and unhiding a hidden index each reset its $indexStats counters. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.hideIndex.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.unhideIndex.md
- [statement] Hiding an already hidden index or unhiding an already visible index does not reset its statistics. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.hideIndex.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/db.collection.unhideIndex.md
- [statement] Usage statistics describe the queried node. Check all relevant replica-set members, including secondaries serving reads, before declaring an index unused. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.pythian.com/blog/how-to-find-unused-index-and-drop-them-safely-in-mongodb, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/measure-index-use.md
- [statement] Internal TTL deletion, chunk split, and migration operations do not increment the reported usage counters. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/
- [statement] A zero ops value does not establish that an index is unnecessary: uniqueness enforcement on insertion does not increment this counter. (low confidence) — https://www.percona.com/blog/identifying-unused-indexes-in-mongodb/
- [statement] For interval monitoring, subtract two index-operation samples only while the node, index identity and statistics-start epoch remain comparable; reject intervals spanning a reset. This is a methodological inference from the documented resets. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://dzone.com/articles/using-mongodb-indexstats-to-identify-and-remove-unused-indexes
- [statement] For a particular query, inspect explain output to establish its execution plan. $indexStats supplies aggregate usage frequency, so its counter alone does not establish that the query used SORT_MERGE. (medium confidence) — https://studio3t.com/whats-new/are-my-mongodb-indexes-being-used-studio3t_ama/ · keywords: $indexStats usage statistics and their reset conditions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/indexStats.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/measure-index-use.md
- [statement] Changing an index from visible to hidden, or hidden to visible, resets its $indexStats. Hiding an already hidden index or unhiding an already visible index does not reset them. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden.md
